description: This file defines classes and functions for managing Interactive Voice Response (IVR) navigation within a software system. It includes an enum for IVR statuses, an IVRProcessor class handling pattern matching, command processing, and state transitions, and an IVRNavigator pipeline class orchestrating LLM interactions for IVR navigation and conversation detection.

classes.name: IVRStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the current state or status of IVR navigation, such as detected, completed, stuck, or waiting.

classes.name: IVRProcessor
classes.description: Class that processes LLM responses related to IVR navigation commands. Handles pattern matching for DTMF tones, IVR states, and mode switching, and manages event emission and context updates.

classes.name: IVRNavigator
classes.description: Pipeline class orchestrating IVR navigation using LLM responses and processing, including automatic classification of input as conversation or IVR and handling state transitions.

methods.name: IVRStatus
methods.description: Enumeration of IVR navigation statuses.

methods.name: IVRProcessor.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IVR processor with prompt configurations and VAD parameters.

methods.name: IVRProcessor.update_saved_messages
methods.description: Updates the list of saved context messages, such as previous conversation history.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._get_conversation_history
methods.description: Retrieves the conversation messages excluding the system message, used for context during IVR mode switching.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._setup_xml_patterns
methods.description: Sets up pattern recognition for DTMF, mode, and IVR command tags, associating them with handler functions.

methods.name: IVRProcessor.process_frame
methods.description: Processes individual frames, handling pattern recognition and message passing for DTMF and IVR statuses.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_dtmf_action
methods.description: Handles DTMF commands extracted from pattern matches, creating appropriate frames for tone playback.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_ivr_action
methods.description: Handles IVR status changes, updating state and triggering associated events.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_mode_action
methods.description: Switches between conversation and IVR modes based on detected mode signals.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_conversation
methods.description: Handles transitions to conversation mode, emitting an event with saved conversation history.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_ivr_detected
methods.description: Activates IVR mode by setting prompts, context, and VAD parameters, and emits status events.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_ivr_completed
methods.description: Handles successful completion of IVR navigation and signals status change.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_ivr_stuck
methods.description: Signals that IVR navigation is stuck or cannot progress.

methods.name: IVRProcessor._handle_ivr_wait
methods.description: Handles waiting state when IVR transcription is incomplete or unclear.

methods.name: IVRNavigator.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the IVR navigation pipeline, setting prompts, linking LLM and IVR processors, and registering event handlers.

methods.name: IVRNavigator.process_frame
methods.description: Intercepts frames to pass context messages to the IVRProcessor for mode detection and switching.

methods.name: IVRNavigator.add_event_handler
methods.description: Registers external event handlers for conversation detection and IVR status changes.
